groups.problem: Delete passes `name` instead of options.Kind as the kind label when it records the storage duration on success.
groups.rationale: All three point at line 106, where `name` is passed as the kind metric label.

groups.problem: The legacy DeleteCollection goroutine records its duration with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.
groups.rationale: All three report the same wrong metric function at line 166.

groups.problem: Storage failure paths in Create and Update call recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.
groups.rationale: The same copy-paste mistake appears in both the Create and Update error paths, and S6 reports it as one problem.

groups.problem: The async legacy goroutines derive their context from the request ctx, which is cancelled when the handler returns.
groups.rationale: All three propose using context.WithoutCancel(ctx) for the background legacy writes.

groups.problem: The legacy Update receives the raw objInfo instead of an updateWrapper holding the object returned by storage, so the two stores can diverge.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same removal of updateWrapper at lines 134-141.

groups.problem: In Delete, the context is built with d.Log instead of the enriched per-call logger.
groups.rationale: Both report the same problem at line 97, where klog.NewContext gets d.Log instead of log.
